text:
Anna (People Ops): Quick ideawe should run a small peer-recognition pop-up next Friday afternoon. Thinking tokens + a snack table + 5-minute shoutouts. :confetti_ball:
Jana (HR): Nice. Do we have to route through the spot-award budget or can this be an informal "thank you" activation?
Anna (People Ops): Intention is informal culture-first (under $25/token). We have a tiny contingency if teams want to convert a token to a voucher later.
Mike - Eng: Who can nominate? Managers only?
Anna (People Ops): Open nominationsanyone can nominate anyone. Short form: nominee name + one-line why. Open for 72 hours.
Sam - UX: I can mock a 1-field Google Form and a mini Notion spot with the poster assets. Want a printable 8.5x11 poster and a 2-line email blurb.
Anna (People Ops): Email copy draft: "Nominate someone for a Bright Moment! Share one quick example of how they made your day or helped ship a tiny win. We'll celebrate Friday at 3pm with snacks and tokens." Keep it warm and low-pressure.
Olive (Facilities): For snacks: need an estimated headcount for 3-4pm. Also need table + two volunteers to set up at 2:30pm and teardown at 4:15pm.
Anna (People Ops): Volunteer slots: setup 2:30-3:00, host table 3:00-4:00, teardown 4:00-4:20. Who can take?
Mike - Eng: I'll take teardown 4:00-4:20.
Sam - UX: I can do setup and bring a little chalkboard sign that says "Bright Moments". Also can print 50 sticker tokens.
Jana (HR): I'll quick-check the recognition policy to confirm token rules (to avoid conflicts with procurement for vouchers). If anything pops up I'll ping legal.
kudos-bot: Auto: Priya was nominated by "data-team" for unblocking the pipeline yesterday! :tada:
Mike - Eng: Nice. Can we get a small list of nominees ahead of time so teams can plan a 30s shoutout?
Anna (People Ops): Yes we'll share the list by noon Friday. Also planning 3 quick mic passes (engineering, product, ops) so it's snappy.
Sam - UX: For the form I suggest: 1) Your name (optional) 2) Nominee 3) One-sentence reason (max 140 chars). I'll attach a tiny example text people can copy.
Anna (People Ops): Perfect. Jana, once you sign off on wording II'll publish the form and send a calendar invite for 3pm Friday.
Jana (HR): Sounds good. Also propose we track nominations in a sheet for audit (simple CSV export).
Olive (Facilities): I'll reserve the south lobby table and order light snacks (vegan options included). Need final headcount by Thursday 11am.
Anna (People Ops): Great. I'll post a short announcement tomorrow with the form link and volunteer sign-up for shifts. Thanks all!
notes: pop-up peer recognition, token budget < $25, volunteer shifts, nominations open 72 hours
